item.name: Stalker
item.counter: Avoid looking directly at it; take corners carefully with the camera angled low
item.warningSigns: Tall black bunny-like figure peeks around corners, may flicker lights, then retreats when spotted
item.cardSummary: A peeking shadow that punishes direct eye contact. Angle your camera low and keep walking.

item.name: Hiders
item.location: Patient rooms and both hospital wings
item.damage: -10 sanity if empty-handed, or steals held item and stuns
item.counter: Taser, gun, fire extinguisher, fire, outrun, or lure into the Bed Monster red zone
item.warningSigns: Flat paper-like figures camouflaged on walls; heavy breathing before they leap off and chase
item.cardSummary: Wall camouflage hunters. Listen for breathing, then stun or run before they steal your tool.

item.name: Ghost
item.damage: About -2 sanity per second while close
item.counter: Reveal with fire extinguisher spray, then tase, shoot, or use fire
item.warningSigns: Doors open alone, floating white particles, ghostly sounds; can turn invisible
item.cardSummary: Death aftermath. Find the invisible presence, spray it visible, then finish it with a weapon.

item.name: Shapeshifter
item.location: Rooms 1-8 and reception after bad admits or transforms
item.damage: About -6 sanity every half second while attacking
item.counter: Taser, gun, or struggle/punch inputs if grabbed
item.warningSigns: Starts as a copy of a known patient, then drops into a white toothy form with heavy breathing and attack alerts
item.cardSummary: The hostile form of a missed anomaly. Drop tools-on-hand and clear it before it eats a patient.

item.name: Bed Monster
item.damage: Grab hits -10 sanity, then about -5 every 2 seconds; kills grabbed patients in about 30 seconds
item.counter: Feed maple syrup, a transplant, or an organ; avoid the red zone empty-handed
item.warningSigns: Red line under the bed, black hands, and red eyes under the frame
item.cardSummary: A bed trap for players and patients. Carry maple syrup and never stand in the red zone empty-handed.

item.name: Mass of Eyes
item.damage: About -2 to -5 sanity every half second while staring
item.counter: Do not look up, or use eye drops
item.warningSigns: On-screen “Don’t look up” style warnings, odd lighting, saliva drips, ceiling flesh mass
item.cardSummary: Ceiling horror that melts sanity if you look. Keep eyes down and treat the patient, or use drops.

item.name: Tendril
item.damage: Kills the patient if the surgery timer fails or wrong tools are used
item.counter: Complete the surgery mini-game; do not tase or shoot it
item.warningSigns: Purple tentacles from the surgery patient and a Room 8 emergency prompt
item.cardSummary: Surgery-only enemy. Weapons kill the patient; only the mini-game sequence saves them.

item.name: Head Banger
item.damage: -20 sanity if forced out the hard way without coffee
item.counter: Offer coffee; wait for it to leave; shooting is a last resort
item.warningSigns: Hollow-eyed visitor smashing the glass and blocking shutters, often between shifts 2 and 5
item.cardSummary: Reception pest, not a hallway chase. Coffee is the clean clear; hard rejects cost a big sanity hit.

item.name: Camera Figure
item.counter: Switch camera or repair the feed before it zooms in
item.warningSigns: Demonic cat-like figure on a broken camera that slowly approaches the screen
item.cardSummary: Only lives on security screens. Leave the feed or fix the camera before the zoom-in scare hits.
